content: Mong nei ngawl dum tawtang le thikkol lianpi a len vantungmi khat van pan a tuaksuk ka mu hi.
Ngul suangnei, tanglai ngulpui, Doaimangpa le Satan zong a kici sia kum tulkhat sung hencip hi,
Mong Nei Ngawl Dumsung ah Satan
Kum tulkhat a bo dong, leitung minam theampo theam thei ngawl tu in, mong nei ngawl dum sungah khiasuk a, khum in a tung pan ceptena khen hi: taciang kum tulkhat a bo ciang in tawmvei tha kik tu hi.

Kumpi tokhum te ka mu a, tua tungah a to te thukhen theina thu pia hi: sapi le a milim a bia ngawl te, ceptena a talki le a khut ah a sang ngawl te, Jesus tetti panna le Pathian kammal atu in ngawngtan a thuak te i thaa te zong ka mu hi; amate sia nungta uh a, Christ taw kum tulkhat sung uk tu uh hi.
Ahihang a dang mithi te sia kum tulkhat a bo dong nungta kik ngawl lai tu uh hi. Hisia sia a masabel thawkikna a hihi.

Amasabel thawkikna sungah a kihel te thuphatoai le mithiangtho te a hihi: amate tungah ni vei thina in thu nei nawn ngawl hi, ahihang amate sia Pathian le Christ i thiampi te hi tu uh a, Ama taw kum tulkhat sung uk khawm tu uh hi.
Kum tulkhat a bo zawkciang in, Satan sia thonginn sung pan in tha tu hi,
Leitung king li a om minam theampo theam tu in pusuak tu hi, Gog le Magog a kici ngal sim tu in kaikhawm tu a: tuipi valbo dung a om senneal za in tam tu uh hi.
Amate sia leitung a zai za in paikhawm tu uh a, mithiangtho te omna mun le a it huai khuapi sia kimum uh hi: taciangin, Pathian kung, vantung pan in mei hong taksuk a, kangtum siat hi.
Hi te a theam Satan zong sapi le leilot kamsang te omna mun, kan taw a ki hel meiliipi sungah khiasuk hi, tua mun ah sun le zan in haksatak in vawtsiatna a tawntung in thuak tu hi.
Taciang a lian mama kumpi thokhum kang khat ka mu a, a tungah a to pa mai pan in van le lei sia taikhia hi; taciang amate atu in omna mun a mu bua uh hi.

Mithi te, a no a lian a vekpi in, Pathian mai ah a ding khawm tek ka mu hi; taciang laibu te phal a: nuntakna laibu a kici a dang laibu zong phal hi: mithi te sia amate sepna te laibu sungah a ki at bang in, khatsim tung thukhen hi.
Tuipi in a sung a mithi te ap hi; taciang thina le hell in zong amate sung a om mithi te ap uh hi: taciang mi theampo amate sepna bang tek in thukhen hi.
Taciang thina le hell sia meiliipi sungah khiasuk hi. Hisia sia nivei thina a hihi.
Akua mapo nuntakna laibu sungah min a ki at a mu ngawl peuma meilipi sungah khiasuk hi.
